'''Graveyard''' is a [[location]] in the [[Inquisition Base]].

== Graveyard Quality ==
'''{{Icon|Graveyard Quality|size=20}} Graveyard Quality''' can be increased by building some blueprints.

[[Corpses]] can be buried in designated locations, and various decorations can then be placed to further improve {{Icon|Graveyard Quality|size=20}}. However, a grave's quality can never exceed the number of {{Skull|White}} possessed by the corpse buried in it. Currently, the maximum {{Icon|Graveyard Quality|size=20}} a single corpse can provide is 14
